item.title: Jibu-ni: Kanazawa's Signature Simmered Duck Stew — Guide
item.description: Jibu-ni is considered one of Kanazawa’s defining traditional dishes, a refined stew of duck or chicken lightly dusted with flour before being gently simmered in a delicate dashi broth alongside seasonal vegetables and wheat gluten, the flour coating giving the broth a subtle thickness as it cooks. The dish is thought to date back several centuries, and its understated, savoury flavour profile is often cited as characteristic of Kaga cuisine’s refined, seasonally attentive cooking style.
